name: youtube-transcript-summarizer
description: Chrome extension to summarize YouTube transcripts

scripts.build:sw: parcel build src/background/service_worker.js --out-dir dist/src --out-file service_worker.js --global globalThis --target browser --no-source-maps --bundle-node-modules
scripts.watch:sw: parcel watch src/background/service_worker.js --out-dir dist/src --out-file service_worker.js --global globalThis --target browser --no-source-maps --bundle-node-modules
scripts.build:cs:youtube: parcel build src/content_scripts/youtube_transcript_fetcher.js --out-dir dist/src --out-file youtube_transcript_fetcher.js --global globalThis --target browser --no-source-maps --bundle-node-modules
scripts.watch:cs:youtube: parcel watch src/content_scripts/youtube_transcript_fetcher.js --out-dir dist/src --out-file youtube_transcript_fetcher.js --global globalThis --target browser --no-source-maps --bundle-node-modules
scripts.build:cs:chatgpt: parcel build src/content_scripts/chatgpt_interactor.js --out-dir dist/src --out-file chatgpt_interactor.js --global globalThis --target browser --no-source-maps --bundle-node-modules
scripts.watch:cs:chatgpt: parcel watch src/content_scripts/chatgpt_interactor.js --out-dir dist/src --out-file chatgpt_interactor.js --global globalThis --target browser --no-source-maps --bundle-node-modules
scripts.build:js: npm run build:sw && npm run build:cs:youtube && npm run build:cs:chatgpt
scripts.build:all: npm run prebuild:all && npm run build:ui && npm run build:js && npm run copy:assets
scripts.copy:assets: cp manifest.json dist/manifest.json && cp -r icons/* dist/icons/ && cp src/offscreen/offscreen.html dist/offscreen/offscreen.html && cp src/offscreen/offscreen.js dist/offscreen/offscreen.js
